name: label-lc0-stockfish-enyo
description: Convert the complete LC0 V6 corpus with Stockfish UCI labels, Enyo runtime normalization, and BulletFormat output

chunk_time_seconds.help: Target wall-clock seconds per adaptively sized chunk

labeler.help: Committed source tree containing the LC0 decoder and Stockfish labeler

input.help: Complete LC0 V6 archive directory; the wrapper rejects undersized fixture directories

engine.help: UCI engine used for search labels (loaded via nnue_file, e.g. Enyo's Stockfish-NNUE-format loader). Deliberately absent from requirements.inputs: each worker compiles its own binary for its own CPU, and Forge's generic input sync pushes the coordinator's copy onto every worker whenever its declared bytes/sha256 don't match a real per-host difference -- or, with neither declared at all, unconditionally on every check. Existence/executability is verified via requirements.commands instead, which does pure local verification with no coordinator sync.

net.help: Stockfish-format NNUE net loaded through the engine's nnue_file UCI option

net_sha256.help: Content hash of {net}, binding task identity to what the net contains rather than where it lives

hash.help: Stockfish hash size in MiB per task

engine_timeout_s.help: Bounded seconds allowed for one Stockfish position

max_records.help: Global raw input-record limit; zero means the entire inventory

split_records.help: Positive planner placeholder used while max_records=0 assigns all files

quiet_only.help: Keep only quiet positions outside check

shards.help: Override the requested Forge task count

sources.name: nnue-labeler
install: PYTHON=python3; test ! -x /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 || PYTHON=/opt/homebrew/bin/python3; test -x .venv/bin/python || "$PYTHON" -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q python-chess
